general.name: Hardware - Estimate Model Year to UDF [Win]
general.description:
Writes an estimated build year from model and CPU to a UDF (default 10). Read-only otherwise; won't overwrite another component's value.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/hardware-estimate-model-year-to-udf-win

variables.name: usrUdfNumber
variables.description: The UDF to write, 1 to 300. Anything else is refused.

variables.name: usrOverwriteForeign
variables.description: No = leave the UDF alone if it holds a value this component did not write. Yes = overwrite it.
